description: Third-party source packages LedgerMath offers beside its published binaries, in the same bucket, at blobs/sha256/<sha256>. scripts/publish-third-party-source.ts creates each one the bucket lacks, with a write that never replaces an object, and reads every one back to check its size and SHA-256. image is the Amazon Linux image infra/runs/stack.ts pins, whose packages the binaries are built with; tests/licences.test.ts fails when the two differ, so a new image cannot leave a stale entry here or in THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md.

sources.name: glibc
sources.why: The GNU C Library is linked into every static benchmark binary (LGPL-2.1-or-later). This is the source package of the glibc-static package the boxes install.
